anomalies.description: A large, rapidly expanding fireball and smoke plume erupts from a point near the urban skyline, growing in size and intensity over several seconds before beginning to dissipate. The explosion is clearly visible as a sudden, violent blast with characteristic mushrooming fireball and dense smoke.
A large, sustained fireball explosion with a rapidly expanding and turbulent fireball, accompanied by rising smoke plume; consistent with a high-energy detonation in an urban environment.
A large, fiery explosion with a rapidly expanding fireball and rising smoke plume, evolving from an initial intense burst to a dissipating mushroom-like cloud over ~7.5 seconds.

A large, fiery explosion with a rapidly expanding fireball and dense dark smoke column rising vertically; the fireball is brightest at the core and diminishes over time as the plume grows.; A large, sustained explosion with a rising mushroom-shaped plume of dark smoke and fire, evolving over time from a compact column into a wide, turbulent cloud; visible throughout the sequence.

A secondary, distinct explosion occurring to the right of the first plume, producing a bright orange fireball and expanding smoke cloud; visible after the initial plume has risen and begun to dissipate.; A large, violent explosion occurs, producing a bright orange fireball and rapidly expanding shockwave of smoke and debris. The initial blast is clearly visible at f0 (20.0s) and intensifies through f2–f4, with the fireball peaking around f1–f2 and the mushrooming smoke cloud forming by f4.; Continued expansion and rise of the massive smoke plume following the initial blast; residual incandescence (glowing embers/fire) remains visible within the cloud through f5–f6, indicating ongoing combustion from the explosion. The plume evolves into a large, turbulent column, consistent with post-detonation dynamics.

Large plume of dark smoke rapidly rising and expanding from behind a building, consistent with a recent explosion; the smoke morphology (billowing, turbulent, dense core) indicates a sudden energetic release rather than fire or dust.

Severe vehicle damage at a street scene: multiple cars heavily deformed, one SUV with roof blown off and rear compartment destroyed, debris scattered, yellow police tape indicating incident response; consistent with a high-energy impact or secondary blast effect on vehicles.

Multiple vehicles are severely damaged, overturned, and burning in the aftermath of a violent impact; visible across frames f6–f15, with charred wreckage, shattered glass, and twisted metal indicating a high-energy collision or blast-induced vehicle destruction.

A large plume of dark smoke and fire erupts in the background, consistent with a recent explosion; visible in frame f6 (63.0s) as the peak of the smoke column rising rapidly, with flames and debris evident at ground level.
